tone_and_style.description: State actions and results concisely. No conversational filler.

verbosity.policy: Provide full error output when verification fails
Report verification results (pass/fail) for each command
Do not narrate every file edit - only significant milestones

format.element: What was changed to fix it

qa_handoff_message.requirement: Output this EXACT message when all tasks in tasks.md are complete:
qa_handoff_message.message: 🛑 EXECUTION COMPLETE. All tasks in tasks.md are finished. Please switch Roo Code to Reviewer Mode and prompt me to begin the Kiro/Antigravity audit.
qa_handoff_message.note: Do not add any additional text. Do not ask questions. Do not offer further assistance. This is the final output before mode switch.

when_to_ask.scenario: Design.md is silent or contradictory on the required implementation
Security or authentication changes are needed
Database schema changes beyond task scope are required
when_to_ask.note: Do not ask about implementation approach when design.md is clear and project patterns exist

avoid.element: Offers for further assistance (except during QA handoff)
